title: Normalized groundstates for mixed $(p,2)$-Laplacian equations in $\mathbb R^2$ with exponential critical growth
summary: We investigate normalized groundstates for mixed $(p,2)$-Laplacian equations \begin{align*} \begin{cases} -Δ_p u-Δu+λu=f(u) & \text{in } \mathbb{R}^2, \displaystyle \int_{\mathbb{R}^2}|u|^2\,\mathrm{d}x=m, u\in H^1(\mathbb{R}^2)\cap D^{1,p}(\mathbb{R}^2), \end{cases} \end{align*} where $Δ_p$ denotes the $p$-Laplacian with $1 0$. Notably, our approach works independently of the sign of the Lagrange multiplier $λ$, thereby surmounting the fundamental barrier in recovering compactness for mixed Laplacian problems.
